questions.stem: In the diagram, the top and bottom lines are parallel. Find the value of \(\alpha\).

figure.html:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 180" width="100%" height="180" style="background:#f8fafc; border-radius:16px; display:block; margin:0 auto;">
  <!-- Parallel lines (Top & Bottom) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="130" x2="350" y2="130" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="350" y2="50" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <path d="M 195 45 L 205 50 L 195 55 Z M 195 125 L 205 130 L 195 135 Z" fill="#475569"/>
  
  <!-- Zigzag segments A(90,130) -> E(130,90) -> F(220,115) -> C(285,50) -->
  <polyline points="90,130 130,90 220,115 285,50" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  
  <!-- Double tick marks indicating AE || FC (exactly parallel at slope -1/45°) -->
  <path d="M 106 114 L 114 106 M 110 118 L 118 110" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M 248 87 L 256 79 M 252 91 L 260 83" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Auxiliary horizontal line through E -->
  <line x1="130" y1="90" x2="230" y2="90" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <text x="160" y="86" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b" font-size="11" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">30°</text>
  
  <!-- Vertex Labels A, E, F, C -->
  <text x="80" y="146" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b" font-size="13" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">A</text>
  <text x="130" y="74" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b" font-size="13" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">E</text>
  <text x="228" y="130" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b" font-size="13" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">F</text>
  <text x="293" y="42" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b" font-size="13" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">C</text>
  
  <!-- Angles -->
  <!-- reflex at E: 290deg -->
  <text x="106" y="96" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6366f1" font-size="11" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">290°</text>
  
  <!-- interior at F: 70deg -->
  <text x="210" y="105" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6366f1" font-size="11" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">70°</text>
  
  <!-- A: alpha -->
  <text x="108" y="124" text-anchor="middle" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="13" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">α</text>
  
  <!-- C: beta -->
  <text x="271" y="68" text-anchor="middle" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="13" font-weight="900" font-family="'Outfit'">β</text>
</svg>

options: ​\(140\) (By drawing an auxiliary parallel line and calculating alternate/co-interior angles)
​\(130\) (Sum of interior angles of a quadrilateral)
questions.hint: Draw a helper parallel line through the middle vertex. The $110^\circ$ splits into $70^\circ$ (alternate with top) and $40^\circ$ (remaining). Then $\alpha$ is co-interior with $40^\circ$.
questions.solution:
1. The reflex angle at the top-left is $290^\circ$, so the interior angle at that vertex is $360^\circ - 290^\circ = 70^\circ$.
2. Draw a helper line through the middle vertex, parallel to both horizontal lines.
3. This splits the $110^\circ$ angle into two parts: the upper part equals $70^\circ$ (alternate angles with the top line), and the lower part = $110^\circ - 70^\circ = 40^\circ$.
4. By co-interior angles between the helper line and the bottom parallel line:
   $$\alpha = 180^\circ - 40^\circ = 140^\circ$$

steps.explain: The reflex angle at E is \(290^\circ\), which means the interior angle at E is \(360^\circ - 290^\circ = 70^\circ\).
By drawing a horizontal auxiliary parallel line through E, the interior angle is split. The top part is given as \(30^\circ\). Therefore, the bottom part of E is \(70^\circ - 30^\circ = 40^\circ\).
By alternate interior angles, the acute angle at A (which is \(180^\circ - \alpha\)) is equal to the bottom part of E, which is \(40^\circ\).

options: ​\(140\) (Since \(\alpha = \beta\) by symmetry and parallel line properties)
questions.hint: The interior angle at the top-left is $360^\circ - 290^\circ = 70^\circ$. $\beta$ is co-interior to this angle.
questions.solution:
1. The reflex angle is $290^\circ$, meaning the interior angle is $360^\circ - 290^\circ = 70^\circ$.
2. The angle $\beta$ and this interior angle of $70^\circ$ are co-interior angles between the parallel lines:
   $$\beta = 180^\circ - 70^\circ = 140^\circ$$

steps.explain: Since the segment AE is parallel to FC (indicated by matching parallel ticks), the angles they make with the parallel horizontal lines are equal.
We solved \(\alpha = 140^\circ\) in the previous part, which directly gives \(\beta = 140^\circ\).
